rationale: CloudTrail records that a query was started, but not how much it read: the data scanned, the execution time and the number of queries are published to CloudWatch only when the workgroup is configured to publish its metrics. Athena is a read path over an entire data lake with no per-row accounting anywhere else, so those metrics are the only continuous signal that distinguishes an analyst running a report from a single query dumping every table it can reach. Without them there is nothing to alarm on and, after the fact, no baseline to compare against.
remediation: Enable PublishCloudWatchMetricsEnabled on the workgroup and alarm on the ProcessedBytes and TotalExecutionTime metrics of its queries
